invariants.rationale: The method requires a non-null file name to load the tiled map.
A load method is expected to return a TiledMap instance, not null, if loading is successful.
The fileName should not be an empty string for file loading to succeed.
The result returned is an instance of TiledMap as specified by the return type.
If fileName is provided, result should not be null, i.e., null result implies something is wrong with the fileName or loading.
